rules.title: Security deposit limit – one month's rent for most landlords
rules.quote: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.summary: Most landlords in California may only charge one month's rent as a security deposit for both unfurnished and furnished units.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.exemption_note: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons

rules.title: Security deposit limit – small landlord exemption
rules.quote: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or limited liability company (LLC) where all members are natural persons
rules.summary: Small landlords who own no more than two rental properties with a total of four or fewer units and are natural persons, family trusts, or certain LLCs may charge up to two months' rent as a security deposit.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent
rules.coverage_text: landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total
rules.exemption_note: Only applies if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons

rules.title: Photograph unit before or at start of new tenancy
rules.quote: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document the condition of the unit.
rules.summary: Landlords must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy that begins on or after July 1, 2025 to document its condition.
rules.effective_date_evidence: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit
rules.coverage_text: tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025

rules.title: Security deposit return deadline
rules.quote: All or any remaining portion of a security deposit must be returned within 21 days after the tenant/s leave the unit vacant.
rules.summary: Landlords must return the security deposit or any remaining portion within 21 days after the tenant leaves the unit.

rules.title: Itemized statement and proof of repairs required
rules.quote: If deductions were made, the landlord must give the tenant a written statement itemizing the amount of and and purpose for any security deposit deductions, accompanied by copies of documents showing charges incurred and deducted by the landlord to repair or clean the premises, including a copy of any bill, invoice, or receipt for materials or supplies deductions.
rules.summary: If a landlord deducts from the security deposit, they must provide an itemized statement and copies of bills, invoices, or receipts showing the charges for repairs or cleaning.

rules.title: Proof of completed repairs required
rules.quote: Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that necessary repairs were completed.
rules.summary: Beginning January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that necessary repairs for which they deducted from the security deposit were completed.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that necessary repairs were completed.

rules.title: Photographs after regaining possession required
rules.quote: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit.
rules.summary: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must photograph a unit after regaining possession but before making any repairs or cleaning for which they intend to deduct from the security deposit.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession

rules.title: Security deposit interest requirement
rules.quote: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
rules.summary: Landlords of units covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance must pay tenants annual interest on their security deposit.
rules.coverage_text: units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance
